analysis.method: Post-run pairing by repetition, role and phase. Savings = 100 * (1 - blocks total / full total). Reasoning and cached input are subsets, not additional charges.
analysis.conclusion: The repeated turn is smaller, but the measured two-turn live sequence uses more total tokens. This does not establish end-to-end task savings.
